summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for splicing reynolds_2001's missing sections 5-8 into the Literature corpus. The plan follows the research report's surgical-splice strategy: extract and hand-fit the sections 5-8 span in scratch, renumber the existing sec04-sec10 files to sec08-sec14 (descending git mv to avoid collision), install four new sec04-sec07 files and splice four hand-authored chunks.json entries with a re-linked prev/next chain, rebuild only the global FTS5 index, and record a dated addendum on specs/literature-index.json. Estimated 3.25 hours across 4 dependency waves; validate-artifact.sh passes with zero warnings.
